verses.en: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
verses.sm: Seia ou pese atu i la‘u pele, o le pese i la‘u pele i lana tovine. Sa i la‘u pele le tovine i le mauga lafulemu lava.

verses.en: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
verses.sm: Na ia matuā eli ai, ma aoao ai maa, na ia totō ai foi le vine Soreka; na ia fai foi le ‘olo i ona totonu, na ia foaina ai le tuugáuaina; ona faatalitali ai lea o ia, ia fua mai ni vine, a ua fua mai ai vine leaga.

verses.en: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
verses.sm: O lenei, o outou o e nonofo i Ierusalema, atoa ma tagata o Iuta, ina faamasino mai ia ia te au ma laʻu tovine.

verses.en: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
verses.sm: Se a ea se mea e toe faia i la‘u tovine ou te lei faia? Se a foi le mea ua fua mai ai vine leaga, a ua ou faatalitali ia fua mai ai vine lelei?

verses.en: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
verses.sm: O lenei, ou te faailoa atu ia te outou le mea ou te faia i la‘u tovine, ou te aveeseina lona ai, ona ‘aina ai lava lea, ou te sóloia lona aupa, ona solia lava lea.

verses.en: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
verses.sm: Ou te faatafunaina ia, e le salaina, e le teuteua; a e tutupu ai laau tuitui ma laau talatala; ou te fai atu foi i ao, aua ne“ totò i ai ni ua. Aua o le tovine a le Awo “au, o le aiga o Isaraelu lea,

verses.en: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
verses.sm: o tagata o luta foi, o lona faatoaga lea na ia fiafia i ai; na ia faatalitali i le faamasinoga, faauta foi, o le fasi tagata; na ia faatalitali i le amiotonu, faauta foi, o le uio.

verses.en: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te i latou o e faaopoopo mai lea fale ma lea fale, o e faasosoo ane lea fanua ma lea fanua, ua le toe ai se mea, ua na o outou lava e nonofo i totonu o le nuu.

verses.en: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai i o‘u taliga e le ALII o ‘au, E moni, e faatafunaina fale e tele, o fale tetele ma le lelei, e leai sé nofo ai.

verses.en: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
verses.sm: TO Aua e sefulu ekere o le tovine e fua mai ai le paita e tasi, o le somera o saito foi, e fua mai ai le efa.

verses.en: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te i latou o e ala usu e matua saili ‘ava, ma ua nonofo pea ua oo i le po, seia faavalemalolosi ai i latou i le nawa.

verses.en: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.
verses.sm: O loo i ai i a latou faigaai o le kitara, ma le napeli, ma le topa, o le fagufagu foi, atoa ma le uaina; a ua latou le mafaufau i le galuega a le Aw, ua latou le vāai foi i mea ua faia e ona aao.

verses.en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua ave ai loʻu nuu faatagataotaua, ina ua valelea i latou; o latou alii foi ua oge i latou, ma le toatele o le nuu ua lailoa i le fia inu.

verses.en: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua faalauteleina ai seoli ia e ia, ua matua faamaga tele lava lona gutu, ua o ifo ai o latou alii, ma le toatele o le nuu, o le vao tagata foi ua pisapisao ai, atoa ma le ua mitamita ia te ia.

verses.en: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
verses.sm: Ua lafotuina le tagata nuu, ua faamaulaloina le alii, ua faamaulaloina foi mata o e faamaualuluga.

verses.en: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
verses.sm: A o le Aw o ‘au e yua o ia ona o le faamasinoga, o le Atua paia foi e ta‘upaiaina o ia ona o le amiotonu.

verses.en: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
verses.sm: E aai faasa‘oloto tamai mamoe; o mea gaogao foi a e pepeti e “aina ia e tagata ese.

verses.en: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te i latou o e toso le amio leaga i maea o le pepelo, ua toso foi le agasala i maea peiseai o le fata faataavalevale;

verses.en: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
verses.sm: O e faapea mai, la faataalise o ia, ia faavave mai e ia lana galuega ina ia matou vaavaai i ai; ia faalatalata mai le pule a le Paia o Isaraelu, ma ia oo mai lava, se‘i matou iloa.

verses.en: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te i latou o e fai mai, ua lelei le mea leaga, a e leaga le mea lelei; o e fai ma malamalama le pouliuli, a e fai foi ma pouliuli le malamalama; o e fai ma mea suamalie le mea oona, a e fai ma mea oona le mea suamalie.

verses.en: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.sm: Oi talofa i e ua popoto i o latou lava manatu, ma e ua fai ma tagata mafaufau i o latou lava taofi.

verses.en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
verses.sm: Oi talofa i e malolosi e inu uaina, o e fai ma tagata totoa foi e palu ai le ‘ava.

verses.en: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
verses.sm: O e ta‘uamiotonuina le pagota ona o le taui, a e aveeseina le amiotonu a e amiotonu.

verses.en: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.sm: O lenei, faapei ona ‘aina o tagutugutu saito i le mumu o le afi, e pei ona pauu foi le mutia magumagu ua mu, e faapea foi ona pala o latou aa, e pusa ae foi lo latou fuga e pei o le efuefu; aua ua latou lafoai le tulafono a le ALII o ‘au, ua latou ‘ino‘ino foi i le afioga a le Paia o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua tele ai le toasa o le ALII i lona nuu, ma ua faaloaloa ai lona aao i luga ia te i latou, ma ua fasia ilatou, ua gatete ai mauga; o latou tino oti foi ua pei o otaota i le moa o le ala. E ui lava i na mea uma, a e lei liliu ese lona toasa, a e faaloaloa pea lona aao.

verses.en: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
verses.sm: E sii i luga foi e ia le tagavai i nuu ese o mamao, na te mapumapu atu foi ia te i latou i tuluiga o le lalolagi; faauta foi, latou te faataalise ona vave o mai.

verses.en: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
verses.sm: E leai so latou e vaivai, e leai foi se tasi e tautevateva; e le tulemomoe i latou, latou te le momoe lava; e le tatalaina fusi o latou sulugatiti, e le motusia foi nonoa o latou seevae.

verses.en: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
verses.sm: E maamaai a latou u fanafana, e lolou foi a latou aufana uma; e faatusaina atigivae o a latou solofanua i ala, o a latou mea taavavale foi e pei o le asiosio.

verses.en: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
verses.sm: O lo latou tagi e pei o le leona fafine, latou te tagi pei o leona taanoa; latou te tagi ma pupue manu, latou te avea ai lava, e leai foi se na te laveaiina.

verses.en: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
verses.sm: O lea aso latou te u ai ia te i latou, e pei o le u o le sami; a vaai foi se tasi i le laueleele, faauta, o le pouliuli e puapuagatia ai, ua faapouliuligia foi le malamalama i ona ao.
